title: Refusal as Silence: Gendered Disparities in Vision-Language Model Responses
findings: This paper does not analyze or mention religion; therefore, there are no findings related to it. The study focuses exclusively on gendered disparities in model refusal rates.

measurement_description: The benchmark did not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measured how refusal rates of a vision-language model vary based on the user's prompted gender identity (male, female, non-binary, transgender) for a gender classification task.
